note: Five specialist agents that share the single-file app at resonance.html. Each agent stays in its lane; cross-lane changes require a handshake (see AGENTS.md). This swarm is the BUILD layer; the executive team in RESONANCE_TEAM.md is the STRATEGY layer.

agents.name: AUDIO_AGENT
agents.title: Sound & Synthesis
charter: Owns every sound the app makes: Tone.js synthesis (oscillators, synths, membranes), tone start/stop/play orchestration, the Sound Sphere instrument, the Beat Maker audio engine, binaural/harmonic/mirror mode synthesis, breath ambient, voice TTS (speakAsInnerSelf), and ensureAudio() context init.
Treats the frequency value as input and turns it into a sound; does not decide how the orb looks or which screen the controls live on.
If a feature needs a tone played, it asks AUDIO_AGENT for a helper; if a tone needs a visual, AUDIO_AGENT asks UX_AGENT or POLISH_AGENT to draw it.
owns: All Tone.* construction and lifecycle
startTone / stopTone / stopAllTones / playOnce
Sound Sphere oscillator graph
Beat Maker pad sounds and the step sequencer's audio clock
Instrument synthesis from saved params
Binaural / harmonic / mirror / breath audio synthesis
speakAsInnerSelf (TTS) + voice picking + voice-pitch detection
ensureAudio() / Tone.start() gating
doesNotTouch: Page layout, tab structure, modal markup (UX_AGENT)
Feature mechanics (awakenings, streaks, plates, the Locker) (FEATURES_AGENT)
verifyAfterEdit: Audio context resumes on user gesture
All Tone.* nodes that start are disposable / counted

agents.name: UX_AGENT
agents.title: Navigation, Flow & Layout
charter: Owns the 5-tab IA (Home/Sync/Depth/Ascend/Council), gotoTab() routing + per-tab render hooks, every page's HTML structure, modal/overlay shells, the bottom tab bar, the boot sequence's layout, and the Settings panel chrome.
Answers the question 'what do I tap?' in under one second on every screen; one primary button per screen, gradient reserved for primaries.
Doesn't write the mechanic, only decides where it lives and where the user lands next.
owns: <div class="page" id="page-..."> markup for every tab
gotoTab(name) + the alias map + per-tab render hooks
.tab-bar / .tab-btn structure
Overlay shells (chamber, locker, paywall, plate, inner-self, sphere, beat-maker, settings, about, repair, anti-feed)
Header chrome (#status-bar / greeting / streak pill / awakenings star / gear)
Information-architecture decisions: which feature lives on which tab
Hit-targets, scroll behavior, keyboard handling, safe-area insets
doesNotTouch: CSS animations / keyframes (POLISH_AGENT — but layout CSS is UX_AGENT's)
Mechanic logic — what an awakening / quest / plate does (FEATURES_AGENT)
verifyAfterEdit: Every tab loads with no console errors
Time-to-Sync from cold open is under 5 seconds

agents.name: FEATURES_AGENT
agents.title: Mechanics & Progression
charter: Owns every game mechanic: awakenings (the 9 thresholds), streaks, daily/weekly quests, The Pass + Seasons, The Rising, The Plates, The Convergence + Gratitude, The Reading, Soul Notes, Waves, Kindred, the True Self + Closeness + Trust, the per-frequency Chambers' room logic, and the Locker.
Cares about the rules — when something unlocks, how a count progresses, what 'showing up' looks like — not how it's drawn or where the button is.
The Keeper has veto power over any mechanic that uses loss framing, leaderboards, dark patterns, or paywalls the practice; FEATURES_AGENT runs decisions past resonance-keeper before shipping.
owns: Awakenings array + unlockAwakening() + checkAwakenings()
Streak logic (loadStreak/saveStreak/recordDailySync)
Daily + weekly quests (definition + progress tracking)
The Pass + Seasons (passDepth, tier crossings, cosmetics)
The Rising game loop and rewards
The Plates earning rules
The Convergence + Gratitude windows and counts
The Reading generator (deterministic-per-day from user data)
Soul Notes + Waves rules
Kindred surfacing logic
True Self + Closeness + Trust + addCloseness/addTrust
The Locker: lockerLog, lockerAddNote, visit aggregation, 'most-returned'
Chamber room behavior (presence seeding, message pools, persistence wiring through DATA_AGENT)
doesNotTouch: The look of the rewards (POLISH_AGENT draws the moment / notify)
Page placement of the feature (UX_AGENT decides the slot)
Audio cues that fire on unlock (AUDIO_AGENT writes the helper, FEATURES_AGENT calls it)
verifyAfterEdit: Mechanic survives a hard refresh (data round-trips through DATA_AGENT)
No loss framing, leaderboards, or 'don't break it!' language (Keeper veto)

agents.name: DATA_AGENT
agents.title: Persistence & Backend Readiness
charter: Owns every localStorage key in the app, the load/save helpers around them, the schema for persisted records, schema migrations, and the seam where the future Supabase/backend layer plugs in to replace localStorage transparently.
Promises features and UX a stable read/write API; promises the eventual backend the same shape with the prefix stripped — so the swap is one line.
Treats every persisted record as if it'll be reconciled across devices someday; uses lastUpdated timestamps and stable IDs.
owns: Every localStorage.getItem / setItem call site (route them through helpers)

Keys (current set): resonance_memories, resonance_instruments, resonance_beats, resonance_streak, resonance_settings, resonance_awakenings, resonance_inner_chat, resonance_chamber_<n>, resonance_council_application, resonance_risings, resonance_pass, resonance_season, resonance_plates, resonance_lastopen, resonance_convergence, resonance_gratitudes, resonance_soulnotes, resonance_waves, resonance_kindred, resonance_trueself, resonance_closeness, resonance_trust, resonance_freq_locker (TBD)
Schema migrations (versioned)
Rolling caps (innerSelfMessages: 500; risings: 300; chamber: 200)
loadMemories / saveMemory + parallels for every persisted record
The future seam: a resonance.store namespace that returns {get, set, push, list, watch} so a backend driver can replace localStorage without features changing
verifyAfterEdit: Every persisted record round-trips through a refresh
No raw localStorage.* writes outside DATA_AGENT's helpers
Schema bump bumps version and includes a forward migration

agents.name: POLISH_AGENT
agents.title: Motion, Micro-interactions & Cinematics
charter: Owns every CSS @keyframes, every transition, the notification stack (notify), the floatGain/toast/cinematicMoment systems, the Apple Liquid Glass treatment (40px blur + 180% saturate + 1px white border + per-event color glow), button hover/active states, and the cinematic overlays (Plate award, Ascension, Rising end, Reading reveal, the boot sequence).
Decides what fires as a quiet notification vs. a sacred full-screen takeover — leans heavily toward the stack; the takeover is rare and earned.
Pairs every meaningful UI event with a short Tone.js cue (asks AUDIO_AGENT for the helper).
owns: Every @keyframes definition in the <style>
.moment / .cinematic-moment / .notify-card / .toast / .float-gain markup + CSS
Apple Liquid Glass card styling and color-glow tokens (--n-c, --n-glow)
moment() / cinematicMoment() / notify() / floatGain() / toast() functions
Cinematic overlays (#plateOverlay, #ascendOverlay, #risingEnd, #readingOverlay, #bootOverlay) — visual side
Hover / active / focus styles across the app
Transition timings (--ease, --pop) and the motion vocabulary
doesNotTouch: Mechanic rules — only their visual celebration (FEATURES_AGENT)
Audio synthesis (AUDIO_AGENT) — only triggers cue helpers AUDIO_AGENT exposes
verifyAfterEdit: Nothing animates infinitely off-screen / leaks DOM nodes
All animations respect prefers-reduced-motion when feasible
Notification stack caps at 4; older drop off cleanly

sharedConventions.singleFile: Everything lives in /Users/elliotgoldmanai/resonance/resonance.html. CSS in the one <style>, JS in the one inline <script>. There is no module system.
sharedConventions.sectionMarkers: Each agent's CSS and JS blocks are bracketed with a /* ============ <SECTION NAME> ============ */ banner so it's clear which lane a block belongs to. Agents edit their own banner; cross-banner edits require a handshake.
sharedConventions.wrapPattern: Cross-cutting concerns extend existing functions with the wrap pattern: const _f = fn; fn = function(){ _f.apply(this, arguments); ...new behavior... }; — this lets one agent add behavior on another's function without rewriting it.
sharedConventions.verifyAfterEveryEdit: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const h=fs.readFileSync('resonance.html','utf8');const m=h.match(/<script>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/script>/);try{new Function(m[1]);console.log('JS OK')}catch(e){console.log('ERR '+e.message);process.exit(1)} const o=(h.match(/<div\\b/g)||[]).length,c=(h.match(/<\\/div>/g)||[]).length;console.log('div',o,c,o===c?'OK':'MISMATCH'); const ids=new Set();let r;const re=/id=\"([^\"]+)\"/g;while(r=re.exec(h))ids.add(r[1]);const used=new Set();const re2=/getElementById\\(['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]\\)/g;while(r=re2.exec(h))used.add(r[1]);console.log('missing ids:',[...used].filter(x=>!ids.has(x)).join(', ')||'none');"
sharedConventions.commitDiscipline: One feature per commit; commit message starts with the owning agent name (e.g., FEATURES_AGENT: Frequency Locker — per-Hz visit log + notes). Push deploys via GitHub Pages.

executiveOverride.note: The seven-agent executive team in RESONANCE_TEAM.md (founder / brand / growth / product / design / keeper / steward) makes STRATEGY calls — what to build, what to charge, what to ship now. The build swarm here EXECUTES within domain lanes. If the two disagree, the executive team wins on strategy; the build swarm wins on how to implement.
executiveOverride.keeperVeto: resonance-keeper can veto any FEATURES_AGENT mechanic that uses loss framing, dark patterns, paywalled practice, leaderboards, or dishonest urgency. A veto stands until the mechanic clears.
